about.title: About
about.body: HelloLWD is a compact briefing of local news and weekend nights for internationals in Leeuwarden. Summaries only. Every story links back to its source.
about.more: We pull public RSS from Omrop Fryslân, Omroep Leeuwarden and LC.nl, add a Leeuwarden weather strip from Open-Meteo, and keep a curated weekend list. No accounts, no comments, no full-article copies.

footer.blurb: Local news and weekend events for internationals in Leeuwarden. Summaries only. Every story links back to its source.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.who: HelloLWD is a local news and weekend briefing for internationals in Leeuwarden, the Netherlands. Contact: hello@hellolwd.nl. The Chamber of Commerce (KVK) number in the footer is a placeholder until the organisation is registered.
privacy.data:
We do not run user accounts, comments, newsletters or ads. We do not sell data.

On our server we store public RSS items (headline, short summary, source link, photo URL, category) and curated weekend events so the site can show them. Your browser does not send us a visitor profile. If you email us, we only keep what you wrote so we can reply.
privacy.cookies: Language lives in the URL (/nl, /en, /es, /fa), not in a tracking cookie. Light or dark theme is stored in localStorage and in a first-party cookie named theme (one year) so the page does not flash. The admin desk sets a first-party cookie named hellolwd_admin after login; that cookie is only for people who edit the site.
privacy.third:
News comes from the public RSS of Omrop Fryslân, Omroep Leeuwarden and LC.nl. We always link back to the original article.

Weather for Leeuwarden is fetched on our server from Open-Meteo. SC Cambuur scores and the Eredivisie table are fetched on our server from ESPN. Translations may be made on our server with Google AI Studio (Gemini) and, if that quota is empty, other machine-translation services. Those requests leave our server. They are not sent from your browser.
privacy.rights: If you think we hold personal data about you, you can ask for access, correction or deletion at hello@hellolwd.nl. You can complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.needed: HelloLWD uses a few first-party cookies to keep the site working. We do not use advertising, analytics or social-media tracking cookies, so we do not show a marketing-consent banner.
cookies.list:
theme — first-party, functional, one year. Remembers light or dark.

hellolwd_admin — first-party, functional, only after an editor logs in at /admin. Not set for ordinary readers.

Language is not a cookie: it is the first part of the address (/fa, /en, /nl, /es).
cookies.notused: No Google Analytics, no ad pixels, no fingerprinting. Weather and news feeds are loaded on the server, so Open-Meteo and the newsrooms do not drop cookies in your browser through this site.
cookies.choice: You can clear cookies and site data in your browser. That resets the theme and signs an editor out of the desk. Questions: hello@hellolwd.nl.
